quest.title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
quest.description: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Mora x19800, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to Gentry Maocai's residence and make inquiries

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be Gentry Maocai's house. He must be loaded, this place is swanky!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How're we gonna find out if Gentry Maocai is in cahoots with the Fatui? Hmm, maybe start by talking to the guards.

talks.objective: Talk to the guards and make inquiries

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: Who goes there?

choices.text: A Mondstadt merchant here for a meeting with Gentry Maocai.

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: Really? He didn't mention anything about a meeting...

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: The Master is dealing with some urgent business today. All prior appointments have been canceled.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Urgent business? ...What is it?

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: The Master has been working on a major business deal recently. He left early this morning to meet with a VIP client.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So where is he now?

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: I'm sorry, the Master has stressed that we must not disclose that information to just anyone...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Just anyone"? Are you saying we are not his VIP clients?

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: N—No! I mean yes, yes you are! Ah... I—I meant no offense, please believe me...

choices.text: Take me to Gentry Maocai or suffer the consequences!

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Master is currently in business negotiations at Xinyue Kiosk!

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: I beg for your mercy! Please, my master will show me no leniency if he finds out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, MY master has much more important things to do than talking to rude guards like you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Luckily for you, your bad attitude will be the last thing on our minds when my master's busy negotiating a big business deal with your boss!

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: Th—Thank you, thank you! May your business forever be blessed by the Lord of Geo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Nice work, {NICKNAME}! Paimon never knew you were such a tough negotiator.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that so? Now Paimon knows not to let your wily ways get the better of her in future!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, seems like the VIP client in question must be one of the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, let's get ourselves over to the Xinyue Kiosk!

choices.text: This could work in our favor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tee-hee! Paimon loves compliments and all... but treating Paimon to some tasty snacks would show that you really mean it!

choices.text: Would you like to explain these extra fees you are incurring to your boss, or shall I?
#I'm {NICKNAME}, a VIP client of your boss'!

response.speaker: Sturdy Wu
response.text: How strange, you're not on the guestlist...

talks.objective: Go to Xinyue Kiosk and eavesdrop on Gentry Maocai
Eavesdrop on Gentry Maocai's conversation with the Fatui

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: I understand. I do. Please do not worry, you have my word that the order will be completed as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Hmm... The subordinate I sent was not quite so optimistic in his appraisal. Is somebody being uncooperative?

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: Ah... We just ran into a minor procurement problem is all. We haven't managed to purchase the Cor Lapis yet.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: But it's nothing for you to worry about. If Chang the Ninth won't sell, I can buy from someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: That would be most ideal. I remind you again that the Fatui care only about the result.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: We are willing to lend a certain degree of support to this transaction. But if it is not completed in time...

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: You may suddenly find our good will comes at a price you cannot afford.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: I understand... I am indebted to you for your protection. You know I would not dream of disappointing you, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: We shall see when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: *sigh* Darn that old man Chang!

talks.objective: Inform Xingqiu of Gentry Maocai's plan

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! You said you had other things to look into, as if you're some sort of man of mystery...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When actually all you meant was you wanted somewhere new to park your backside while you read your book!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We know what Gentry Maocai's up to now.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I see. I guessed as much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you really guess, or are you just saying that to sound clever?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: The course of action we must take is now clear. To start with, please deliver this letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. They will know what to do.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: My liege, for reasons that I cannot explain, I will be unable to join you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: There is no need for you to read the contents of the letter, when the time comes—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, this writing is super hard to read! Paimon can't make heads or tails of it...

choices.text: It's in an ancient script, perhaps?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hence why I said there's no need for you to read it...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: The Feiyun Commerce Guild will have someone who can understand it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why do you wanna get them involved? They're one of the bigwig commerce guilds in Liyue — why would they wanna help us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is the Feiyun Commerce Guild?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we got to Liyue, Paimon keeps hearing people mention it. Seems they oversee a lot of business that goes on around here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Having such big backing would be great and all... But are you sure they'd wanna help?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: No need to worry about that. From what I know, they share my sense of chivalry.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Once they have read the carefully reasoned and passionately argued case I put forth in this letter, they will certainly be moved to action.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Gentry Maocai must be taught a lesson he will never forget. This is something we cannot do on our own.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Also, I do not wish for anyone else to know of my involvement in this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why not? You're only doing this to try and help Chang the Ninth, right?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: "To silently disappear at the matter's conclusion, concealing one's name and contribution," this is the chivalrous thing to do. To savor the memory is ample reward.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Each droplet of kindness I receive I am duty-bound to repay with a welling spring of gratitude. I seek neither praise nor reward.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds very lovely. But be honest — you just want them to do it so you can carry on reading your book, don't you?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Thank you in advance for delivering this letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Someone from the guild should be able to receive you near Liuli Pavilion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Stop ignoring Paimon!

choices.text: A secret text that needs a cipher perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: I'm sorry if my mistake earlier caused any offense...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So how do we find out whether Gentry Maocai really is colluding with the Fatui or not?

choices.text: We need to find a smoking gun.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... shall we just go look for him? Best-case scenario, we'll catch him red-handed; if not, we can try threatening him and see if he squeals.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's speak to the guards first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, boss! Whatever you say, boss!

choices.text: We need to catch him red-handed.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: You go first. No need to wait for me.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: One more page and I'll go and stretch my legs. Just one last page.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Mr. Gentry Maocai is colluding with the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knows if Guhua Geek has made any progress. Should we go tell him?
